spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin after a close beyond a new 20-day high with prior marker at least 3 sessions earlier, exiting within 2-6 bars with stop below signal low.
assumptions: Asset BTCUSDT chosen to represent Bitcoin (BTC) from Binance exchange.
Timeframe 1d chosen as daily-bar reading for 20day highs and 2-6 candlestick intervals; claim names no timeframe.
Direction long-only from Buy entry; low-breakout short side not compiled because only one direction allowed.
Entry signal evaluated on bar close and filled at next bar open approximates next day at the previous 20 day high/low watermark.
Three-session gap encoded as prior two closes not breaking their own 20-bar highs, ensuring prior marker at least 3 sessions before signal.
Stop below latest high/low has no percent given, compiled as 2% fixed stop; see free_parameters.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: exact stop price below the signal-bar low and exact limit entry at the prior 20-day watermark price; approximated with fixed-percent stop and next-open fill.
Exit within 2-6 intervals compiled as max_hold_bars 4 as midpoint; no other exit trigger stated.

evidence.quote: makes a new 20day high or low and the previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior. … The close of the new high/low must be greater than (beyond) the previous high/low price marker
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
Stop entries for failed trades are placed below the latest high/low that triggered the signal
Profits/exits should be taken within 2-6 candlestick intervals
Buy entry is placed on the next day at the previous 20 day high/low watermark

audit_majors: entry: Claim requires buys on both new 20-day highs and new 20-day lows; spec encodes only high breakouts and omits the symmetric low-breakout buy signals.
stop_loss_pct: Claim defines stop as price below the latest high/low that triggered the signal with no percent; spec invents a 2% fixed stop with 1-4% sweep instead of the signal-bar price level.
entry: Claim requires buy entry next day at the previous 20-day watermark limit price; spec buys unconditionally at next open rather than conditional fill at the watermark price.
